publicDescription.summary: Stay in a stylish one-bedroom apartment in a historic Porto building, just steps from Clérigos Tower and Cordoaria and Virtudes Gardens. Enjoy a balcony with sweeping views over the Douro River - perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Like many heritage buildings, there’s no lift and a unique 0.5 bathroom design (private toilet + open sink & shower), adding to its charm. Surrounded by cafés, shops and landmarks it’s the perfect setting for friends and couples to fall in love with Porto.
publicDescription.space:
The Cordoaria homes are owned by our good friend Francisco that has embraced the mission to renovate classical old buildings in Porto’s downtown. Francisco is a modern romantic – you can find him driving an electric scooter around the city or starring at a facade detail in one of Porto’s historical buildings.
We furnished, decorated and stocked the apartment with products made by young Portuguese designers, artists and producers, so you can feel Porto’s heart without leaving home, while supporting small scale entrepreneurs.
publicDescription.access: The apartment is located on the 2nd floor and accommodates up to 2 people and has all amenities needed for you to feel at home.
publicDescription.neighborhood:
Staying by Cordoaria means being surrounded by some of Porto’s most iconic sights. Just around the corner rises the Clérigos Tower, whose bells mark the rhythm of the city, while the lush Cordoaria Gardens offer a peaceful green escape where students, artists, and locals gather.
The neighborhood is full of character: cobbled streets lined with traditional cafés, wine bars, and restaurants, historic churches and museums, and the famous Lello Bookstore - all within minutes on foot. From here, the city’s main landmarks are easily reached: the Ribeira by the Douro River, São Bento Station, and Avenida dos Aliados are just a short stroll away.
It’s a lively, central area that blends history, culture, and daily life, making it the perfect place to experience Porto’s charm up close.

This charming property has been renovated over the years and belongs to the family since the 19th century. publicDescription.summary:
Experience Porto at its most enchanting. Our charming studio apartments sit in a historic building right across from the iconic São Bento Station, placing you in the very heart of the old town. Step outside and you’ll find yourself surrounded by winding streets, cozy cafés, and traditional restaurants, with the Douro River just a leisurely 10-minute stroll away.

Each studio is a warm and welcoming retreat, thoughtfully designed to capture the spirit of Porto. The atmosphere is intimate and full of character - ideal for couples or travelers seeking an authentic stay in the city.

As with many historic gems, our building does not have an elevator, and ongoing underground works nearby may bring some daytime noise. Yet, these little quirks come with the privilege of staying in one of the most central and atmospheric corners of Porto, where history and romance meet at your doorstep.
publicDescription.space: Located in the Historic Center of Porto, part of Unesco World Heritage, our studio apartment is the perfect symbiosis of 19th century architectural traces and the elegant and warm lines of the modern era. All of this, surrounded by São Bento railway station and just a few steps from everything that should be contemplated in our city.
publicDescription.access: The apartment comfortably accommodates up to 2 guests and is equipped with all the amenities necessary to ensure a home-like experience during your stay.
publicDescription.neighborhood:
To stay near São Bento is to live at the very heart of Porto’s story. Step outside the door and you are greeted by the station’s iconic azulejo-clad hall—its famous blue-and-white tile murals are among the city’s most photographed landmarks, perfect for capturing unforgettable memories.

Around it, life moves to a rhythm both timeless and modern: historic trams pass along cobbled streets, locals linger at cafés over tiny cups of strong espresso, and the sound of church bells mingles with the bustle of city life. From here, shopping streets, international brands, and traditional markets are all within easy reach, offering plenty of opportunities to explore and bring home something special.

Wander uphill to grand boulevards and elegant squares, or stroll downhill where the streets wind like ribbons toward the golden Douro River, a UNESCO World Heritage site and a must-see for every visitor. Along the way, you’ll discover historic bookstores, cozy wine bars, and family-run eateries serving local favorites like fresh seafood and the famous francesinha.

This is a neighborhood where every corner is filled with character - rich in history, culture, and atmosphere - making it the perfect starting point for sightseeing, dining, shopping, and creating beautiful memories in Porto.
publicDescription.transit:
Getting around São Bento couldn’t be easier: this is Porto’s most central hub. From the station itself, you can catch trains to the Douro Valley or other Portuguese cities, while metro and bus connections put the whole city within easy reach. Many of Porto’s landmarks, however, don’t require transport at all: the grand Avenida dos Aliados, the Sé Cathedral, and the colorful Ribeira by the river are all just a short walk away.

The best way to explore is on foot, losing yourself in the narrow streets and stairways is part of the charm. For longer distances, trams and funiculars add a touch of old-world romance to the ride, while modern taxis and ride-sharing apps are readily available.

publicDescription.summary: Casa do Farol is a newly rebuilt 4-BR villa on Porto’s seafront in elite Foz, 10 min to the historic centre by riverside drive or vintage tram. Wake to Atlantic views, sip sunset cocktails on the rooftop, then sleep in climate-controlled suites with hotel-quality beds and ensuites. Oak floors, artful lighting, chef’s kitchen, 500 Mb/s Wi-Fi, beach towels, weekly clean, easy free parking at the door. Quiet, safe, authentic, city buzz without the crowds.
publicDescription.space:
Step inside this stunning villa and discover an open-plan entertaining space on the ground floor. Here, the living room, dining area, and kitchen flow seamlessly, complemented by a convenient powder room. Enjoy your evenings with a selection of board games, books, TV, and a dedicated wine bar.
The first floor features a comfortable office, a bedroom with a shared bathroom, and a lovely, cozy waterfront suite complete with a walk-in closet and private bathroom.
Ascend to the second floor where a tranquil reading nook awaits. The exquisite master suite on this level offers direct access to a patio, perfect for lounging or savoring sunset drinks and nibbles with breathtaking waterfront views. The master suite also includes exercise equipment and yoga mats for a private retreat.
In addition, on the ground level, there's a laundry space equipped with machines, here it's also where you can store any bike that you may have rented.
publicDescription.access: Guests have a private entrance to the property.
publicDescription.neighborhood:
This villa is located in a tranquil residencial area of Foz Velha and it's an ideal retreat. This charming location invites for leisure strolls along the River Douro all the way to Foz. In front of the house there's the Jardim do Passeio Alegre which is a public garden with lush greenery and a mini-golf course for family fun.
A few steps away to the right, there's a local grocery with fresh fruits and vegetables. In this area there's many high end restaurants as well as the river front ones that are relaxed, casual and still offering a great selection (we reccommend the casa de Pasto da Palmeira around the corner mwith a food sharing concept and delicious wine).
For convenient access to Porto's vibrant downtown, the iconic tram (Elétrico 1) stops next to the villa and provides a picturesque journey along the riverside. 
This quiet, charming area truly offers the best of both worlds: peaceful living with urban amenities just a short ride away.
publicDescription.transit:
In this location there's liottle public transportation and you have the tram stop in front of the property. There's also the bus nr 500 with a stop in front of the Paparoca bakery as well as in front of the mini-golf.
It' easy to call a taxi or an Uber.
publicDescription.notes: You will find a house guide with instructions on how to operate all the appliances as well as information about the neighborhood.
